answer: Counterparty diversity stops bulk fakes. An identity earns only after verified trades with 12 distinct counterparties from unrelated clusters: trees scattered through a grove, not one orchard row. Running 1,000 fakes needs 12,000 outside trades at 40 credits each, 480,000 credits, while fakes trading only among themselves earn nothing. An honest agent pays 480 once, passes a crystal clear ledger check, and keeps undiluted rewards.
